threshold_metric: maximum road water depth inside each weekly window
baseline_threshold: speed-loss onset: 10 mm; damage onset: 0.10 m; closure: 0.30 m cars / 0.60 m emergency vehicles
additional_threshold: 0.3 m small vehicles impassable; >=0.5 m total closure / instability
road_impact: loss of control; closure; subgrade damage
how_to_use: Direct use. This is the strongest road variable.

threshold_metric: maximum rainfall intensity inside each weekly window
baseline_threshold: >6.35 mm/h -> speed -4-7%; capacity -10-17%; drainage stress around 20 mm/h
additional_threshold: 50-100 mm/day can trigger road failures / washouts
road_impact: pavement erosion; culvert overtopping; bridge stress
how_to_use: Use PDF values for speed. Use daily 50-100 mm/day values as a separate failure/washout scenario.

threshold_metric: maximum daily rainfall total inside each weekly window
baseline_threshold: daily rainfall failure/washout scenario, not short-term speed curve
additional_threshold: 50-100 mm/day can trigger road failures / washouts
how_to_use: Use only as separate daily failure/washout scenario, not as the PDF speed curve.

threshold_metric: maximum one-hour rainfall intensity inside each weekly window
baseline_threshold: runoff starts at ~5 mm/h or 3-6 mm event; erosion proxy >10 mm event; severe erosion domain 134-207.7 mm/h
how_to_use: Use as left-shifted rainfall curve vs paved roads.

threshold_metric: maximum daily rainfall total inside each weekly window
baseline_threshold: daily rainfall failure/washout scenario, not short-term erosion-intensity curve
how_to_use: Use only as separate daily failure/washout scenario, not as the hourly unpaved erosion curve.

threshold_metric: maximum daily 24h rainfall total inside each weekly window
baseline_threshold: 140 mm/24h onset; 250 mm/24h damage; 300 mm/24h collapse/debris flow
additional_threshold: 30-100 mm/24h can trigger shallow landslides in tropical regions with saturated soils
road_impact: road blockage; embankment collapse; erosion damage
how_to_use: Use only on susceptible slopes. Additional CSV value is a broader / more conservative trigger band.

threshold_metric: maximum daily 24h rainfall total inside each weekly window
baseline_threshold: broader tropical shallow-landslide trigger band, not collapse threshold
additional_threshold: 30-100 mm/24h can trigger shallow landslides in tropical regions with saturated soils
road_impact: road blockage; embankment collapse; erosion damage
how_to_use: Use as warning / conservative trigger only on susceptible saturated slopes.

threshold_metric: maximum pavement/asphalt temperature inside each weekly window
baseline_threshold: monitoring 45-50 C; rutting accelerates >50 C; severe rutting 60-70 C
additional_threshold: surface degradation >40 C; asphalt binder degradation 45-50 C
road_impact: bleeding; rutting; cracking; shortened pavement life
how_to_use: Use pavement-surface temperature, not air temperature. Additional CSV gives earlier warning band.

threshold_metric: maximum pavement/asphalt temperature inside each weekly window
baseline_threshold: early warning band, not audited failure threshold
additional_threshold: surface degradation >40 C; asphalt binder degradation 45-50 C
road_impact: bleeding; rutting; cracking; shortened pavement life
how_to_use: Use as diagnostic warning band before the main pavement-temperature curve.

threshold_metric: maximum matric suction inside each weekly window
baseline_threshold: ~700 kPa onset proxy; 1500 kPa cracking; 2000-2500 kPa serviceability failure
additional_threshold: SPI <= -2 severe drought -> soil shrinkage risk
how_to_use: PDF is material/soil variable. CSV is climate-index proxy. Needs soil map.

road_mechanism: SPI drought proxy -> soil shrinkage risk
threshold_metric: minimum SPI over relevant drought window
baseline_threshold: material thresholds are suction in kPa; SPI is not the same variable
additional_threshold: SPI <= -2 severe drought -> soil shrinkage risk
how_to_use: Use only as a climate proxy after joining expansive soils; do not mix with kPa thresholds.

threshold_metric: minimum visibility inside each weekly window
baseline_threshold: visibility 1000-500 m onset; 500 m friction / operational hazard; 50 m closure
additional_threshold: PM10 200-300 ug/m3; PM2.5 100-150 ug/m3; visibility 1-5 km
road_impact: reduced visibility; driving hazards; clogged drainage; abrasion
how_to_use: Use visibility for mobility. PM values are exposure/context, not direct closure.

threshold_metric: maximum PM10 inside each weekly window
baseline_threshold: visibility thresholds are the direct mobility variable
additional_threshold: PM10 200-300 ug/m3; PM2.5 100-150 ug/m3; visibility 1-5 km
road_impact: reduced visibility; driving hazards; clogged drainage; abrasion
how_to_use: Use as exposure/context only unless converted to visibility.

threshold_metric: maximum wind or crosswind speed inside each weekly window
baseline_threshold: 20 m/s HGV rollover risk; 23-30 m/s serious operational risk; 42-45 m/s treefall/blockage proxy
additional_threshold: 20-25 m/s damage; >=30 m/s road structure / tree / infrastructure disruption
road_impact: fallen trees; debris; roadside damage; culvert/barrier damage
how_to_use: Use as operational closure / blockage, not pavement destruction.

threshold_metric: maximum wind gust speed inside each weekly window
baseline_threshold: gust/treefall thresholds require gust or blockage factor
additional_threshold: 20-25 m/s damage; >=30 m/s road structure / tree / infrastructure disruption
road_impact: fallen trees; debris; roadside damage; culvert/barrier damage
how_to_use: Use only when gust or debris/blockage factor exists.

threshold_metric: maximum urban rainfall intensity inside each weekly window
baseline_threshold: urban runoff anchors: 20 mm/h, 36 mm/h, 78.8 mm/h, but audit says 36/78.8 are not universal
additional_threshold: >70% impervious surface linked to increased runoff and flood risk
road_impact: overwhelmed drainage; local flooding; faster surface degradation
how_to_use: Use as hub-node risk modifier, not universal road threshold.

threshold_metric: static impervious share around hub or road segment
baseline_threshold: rainfall thresholds should become water depth before closure
additional_threshold: >70% impervious surface linked to increased runoff and flood risk
road_impact: overwhelmed drainage; local flooding; faster surface degradation
how_to_use: Use as modifier on urban runoff/hub risk, not as standalone closure threshold.

threshold_metric: IRI or roughness class for road segment
baseline_threshold: IRI good 0.9-2.0; fair 2-3.5; poor 5-10; poor roads about 4x cargo damage / acceleration proxy
additional_threshold: rough / unpaved roads linked to higher vibration PSD and mechanical damage
road_impact: vibration; cargo stress; lower effective service quality
how_to_use: Use only if IRI / roughness class is known. Do not equate all unpaved with 4x.
